meta.siteDescription: Documentation for EmberKit — a minimalist, TypeScript-first JSX framework built for speed, minimal weight, and selective hydration.
meta.homeDescription: The TypeScript-first JSX framework where speed comes first — fast SSR, pre-rendered static routes, and selective hydration.

home.tagline: Speed First · TypeScript · Zero JS by Default
home.hero: The TypeScript-first JSX framework where {strong}speed comes first{/strong} — fast SSR, pre-rendered static routes, and selective hydration instead of shipping a heavy client runtime.
home.whySubtitle: Everything you need to build fast, lightweight web applications without the bloat.
home.featureSpeedDesc: SSR and pre-rendered HTML for fast TTFB and paint. Targeted signal updates — no full-tree client re-renders.
home.featureWeightDesc: Sub-10KB runtime goal, tree-shakeable. Static pages can ship zero framework JavaScript.
home.featureZeroDesc: Only interactive regions hydrate. Static content stays pure HTML.
home.featureTsDesc: File-based routes, typed params, and JSX with @emberkit/core.
home.ctaSubtitle: Fast by design: server HTML, pre-rendered static routes, and hydration only where you need interactivity.
